negative_snippets:
We were a group of friends from Delhi NCR looking for a quick getaway — something not too far but still giving us a sense of being away from the city. Based on the good reviews and photos, we decided to stay at Sukoon Farms.

Positives:
•	The farmhouse was clean and well-maintained.
•	The caretakers were friendly and helpful.
•	The kitchen was accessible with utensils available, which made things convenient.
•	The pool table was a nice addition to the common hangout space.

However, there were some drawbacks:
•	The design of the common area wasn’t ideal for group gatherings. The sitting area felt closed off, almost like being at home, with no view of the lush green lawn.
•	The dining table was on the ground floor, away from where we usually gathered, making it slightly inconvenient.
•	The balcony with a view of the lawn was on the opposite side and not connected to the main common area.

Since our plan was to spend most of the time together as a group, these structural aspects made the experience less refreshing than we had hoped. It didn’t provide the sense of openness and change in scenery that we were looking for in a farmhouse stay.

This is purely feedback on the property’s design and not on the caretakers or the owner, who were cordial. It would have been much better if the farmhouse had glass doors or large windows opening to the lawn, giving a more open and connected feel.

Lastly, given the amenities and the way the property is structured, the charges felt quite high. In our opinion, it wasn’t value for money.

Overall: Great staff and cleanliness, but the property’s design and pricing did not meet our expectations.
